hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched from off to on, and the code path it enables (src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32) raises ZeroDivisionError on account-page requests. Errors jump from ~1% to 21-36% in the exact minute the flag starts evaluating 'on' (15:16), and every error line after that names the ZeroDivisionError in the spend-summary code.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-16T15:16:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32
Before the toggle, every minute logged 'monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations' with only sporadic 'UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out' errors and 0-2% error rate
error_rate jumps from 0.01 at 15:15 to 0.21 at 15:16 and stays at 0.26-0.355 thereafter, with request_volume flat at 1200 and latency unchanged

{"kind": "flag-toggle", "occurred_at": "2026-09-16T15:24:49Z", "reference": "monthly-spend-feature", "summary": "feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on", "actor": "Argus"} - the remediation recorded as 'set off' left the flag on, and logs still show 'monthly-spend-feature=on' at 15:24, which explains why the service did not recover
